# Generated imagery

Created using the built-in imagegen tool. These are fictional editorial images, not photographs of Deniss.

- `images/hero-person.png`: monochrome full-body developer, black jacket and trousers, closed laptop at side, relaxed three-quarter pose, transparent alpha background.
- `images/about-person.jpg`: cinematic monochrome young developer working at laptop, gray studio wall, soft window light, landscape composition, subject on right.
- `images/project-01.jpg` through `project-04.jpg`: four independent monochrome editorial photographs generated as a contact sheet, extracted into individual assets: tire tread on pale gray studio background; black headphones on a dark desk; server rack with white indicator lights; folded paper sculpture on charcoal background. No text or logos. These are conceptual cover images rather than screenshots of finished applications.
